+def _additional_key_pattern(excluded_keys: List[str]) -> str:
+    """Match an attribute name other than a declared property.
+
+    Subtract declared names using a trie rather than lookahead. Positive
+    Unicode ranges keep exclusions correct for non-ASCII property names.
+    """
+    allowed = r'[^"& \t\r\n\f\v=<>]'
+    if not excluded_keys:
+        return allowed + "+"
+    trie: Dict[str, Any] = {"": True}
+    nodes = [trie]
+    for key in excluded_keys:
+        if not re.fullmatch(allowed + "+", key):
+            continue
+        node = trie
+        for char in key:
+            if char not in node:
+                node[char] = {}
+                nodes.append(node[char])
+            node = node[char]
+        node[""] = True
+
+    patterns = {}
+    for node in reversed(nodes):
+        chars = sorted(key for key in node if key)
+        alternatives = [""] if "" not in node else []
+        excluded = sorted({ord(char) for char in '"& \t\r\n\f\v=<>' + "".join(chars)})
+        ranges = []
+        start = 0
+        for stop in [*excluded, 0x110000]:
+            if start < stop:
+                first = f"\\u{start:04x}" if start <= 0xFFFF else chr(start)
+                last = f"\\u{stop - 1:04x}" if stop - 1 <= 0xFFFF else chr(stop - 1)
+                ranges.append(first if start == stop - 1 else first + "-" + last)
+            start = stop + 1
+        other = "[" + "".join(ranges) + "]"
+        alternatives.append(other + allowed + "*")
+        alternatives.extend(
+            re.escape(char) + patterns[id(node[char])] for char in chars
+        )
+        patterns[id(node)] = "(?:" + "|".join(alternatives) + ")"
+    return patterns[id(trie)]
+

+class TestTrailingIncompleteCall(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_partial_next_opener_is_reported_at_each_cutoff(self):
+        """A generation cutoff inside the next opener must not hide truncation."""
+        first = _call_block("probe", 1, {"count": ("number", "1")})
+        for size in [1, 7, 23, 10000]:
+            for cutoff in range(1, len(CALL_OPEN) + 1):
+                with self.subTest(size=size, cutoff=cutoff):
+                    detector = KimiK3Detector()
+                    wire = TOOLS_OPEN + first + CALL_OPEN[:cutoff]
+                    _, calls = _stream(detector, _chunks(wire, size), [])
+                    assert len(calls) == 1
+                    assert json.loads(calls[0].parameters) == {"count": 1}
+                    with self.assertLogs(
+                        "sglang.srt.function_call.kimik3_detector", level="WARNING"
+                    ):
+                        assert detector.finish([]).calls == []
+
+    def test_completed_call_does_not_hide_truncation(self):
+        """Report an unfinished call even when a preceding call was emitted."""
+        first = _call_block("probe", 1, {"count": ("number", "1")})
+        second = (
+            '<|open|>call tool="probe" index="2"<|sep|>'
+            '<|open|>argument key="count" type="number"<|sep|>2'
+        )
+        for size in [1, 7, 23, 10000]:
+            for complete_first in [False, True]:
+                with self.subTest(size=size, complete_first=complete_first):
+                    detector = KimiK3Detector()
+                    wire = TOOLS_OPEN + (first if complete_first else "") + second
+                    _, calls = _stream(detector, _chunks(wire, size), [])
+                    assert len(calls) == int(complete_first)
+                    if calls:
+                        assert json.loads(calls[0].parameters) == {"count": 1}
+                    with self.assertLogs(
+                        "sglang.srt.function_call.kimik3_detector", level="WARNING"
+                    ):
+                        assert detector.finish([]).calls == []
+
+    def test_complete_call_has_no_truncation_warning(self):
+        """A completed tools section must not trigger the new tail warning."""
+        first = _call_block("probe", 1, {"count": ("number", "1")})
+        for size in [1, 7, 23, 10000]:
+            for suffix in [
+                "",
+                TOOLS_CLOSE,
+                TOOLS_CLOSE + "<|open|>",
+                TOOLS_CLOSE + "<|open|>ca",
+            ]:
+                with self.subTest(size=size, suffix=suffix):
+                    detector = KimiK3Detector()
+                    _, calls = _stream(
+                        detector, _chunks(TOOLS_OPEN + first + suffix, size), []
+                    )
+                    assert len(calls) == 1
+                    with self.assertNoLogs(
+                        "sglang.srt.function_call.kimik3_detector", level="WARNING"
+                    ):
+                        assert detector.finish([]).calls == []
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__]))

+class TestAdditionalPropertyNames(CustomTestCase):
+    def _check(self, tool, body, expected):
+        tag = get_kimik3_structural_tag([tool], tool_choice="required")
+        wire = _tools_section(_call("probe", 1, body))
+        assert _accepts(xgr.Grammar.from_structural_tag(tag), wire) == expected
+        assert _token_accepts(tag, wire) == expected

+    def test_declared_key_cannot_be_overwritten_by_additional_argument(self):
+        """A later extra argument must not replace a schema-checked value."""
+        for extra in [True, {"type": "string"}]:
+            for key in ["count", "co", "é", "a-b", "a]b", "a^b", "a\\b"]:
+                with self.subTest(extra=extra, key=key):
+                    tool = Tool(
+                        type="function",
+                        function=Function(
+                            name="probe",
+                            strict=True,
+                            parameters={
+                                "type": "object",
+                                "properties": {key: {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1}},
+                                "required": [key],
+                                "additionalProperties": extra,
+                            },
+                        ),
+                    )
+                    first = _argument(key, "number", "1")
+                    self._check(tool, first, True)
+                    self._check(
+                        tool, first + _argument(key + "x", "string", "ok"), True
+                    )
+                    self._check(
+                        tool, first + _argument(key, "string", "invalid"), False
+                    )
+
+    def test_skipped_optional_property_keeps_its_schema(self):
+        """Skipping an optional property must not admit it as an untyped extra."""
+        for extra in [True, {"type": "string"}]:
+            with self.subTest(extra=extra):
+                tool = Tool(
+                    type="function",
+                    function=Function(
+                        name="probe",
+                        strict=True,
+                        parameters={
+                            "type": "object",
+                            "properties": {
+                                "a": {"type": "integer"},
+                                "ab": {"type": "integer"},
+                            },
+                            "required": ["ab"],
+                            "additionalProperties": extra,
+                        },
+                    ),
+                )
+                required = _argument("ab", "number", "1")
+                self._check(tool, _argument("a", "number", "1") + required, True)
+                self._check(tool, required + _argument("abc", "string", "ok"), True)
+                self._check(tool, required + _argument("a", "string", "invalid"), False)
+
+    def test_escaped_declared_names_keep_their_round_trip(self):
+        """Tightening extras must preserve escaped names without double unescaping."""
+        for key in ["a&b", 'a"b', "a&quot;b"]:
+            with self.subTest(key=key):
+                tool = Tool(
+                    type="function",
+                    function=Function(
+                        name="probe",
+                        strict=True,
+                        parameters={
+                            "type": "object",
+                            "properties": {key: {"type": "integer"}},
+                            "required": [key],
+                            "additionalProperties": True,
+                        },
+                    ),
+                )
+                escaped = key.replace("&", "&").replace('"', """)
+                first = _argument(escaped, "number", "1")
+                self._check(tool, first, True)
+                self._check(tool, first + _argument("extra", "string", "ok"), True)
+                self._check(
+                    tool, first + _argument(escaped, "string", "invalid"), False
+                )
+                wire = _tools_section(_call("probe", 1, first))
+                result = KimiK3Detector().detect_and_parse(wire, [])
+                assert json.loads(result.calls[0].parameters) == {key: 1}
+
+    def test_nested_schema_cannot_be_bypassed_by_an_extra(self):
+        """An additional argument must not replace a validated nested object."""
+        nested = {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {"count": {"type": "integer"}},
+            "required": ["count"],
+            "additionalProperties": False,
+        }
+        for extra in [True, {"type": "object"}]:
+            with self.subTest(extra=extra):
+                tool = Tool(
+                    type="function",
+                    function=Function(
+                        name="probe",
+                        strict=True,
+                        parameters={
+                            "type": "object",
+                            "properties": {"config": nested},
+                            "required": ["config"],
+                            "additionalProperties": extra,
+                        },
+                    ),
+                )
+                first = _argument("config", "object", '{"count":1}')
+                self._check(tool, first, True)
+                self._check(tool, first + _argument("extra", "object", '{"x":1}'), True)
+                for invalid in ['{"count":"bad"}', "{}", '{"count":1,"extra":1}']:
+                    self._check(tool, _argument("config", "object", invalid), False)
+                self._check(
+                    tool,
+                    first + _argument("config", "object", '{"count":"bad"}'),
+                    False,
+                )
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__]))
